def fill(g):
    g=[r[:] for r in g]; n=30
    def val(i,j): return g[i][j] if 0<=i<n and 0<=j<n else None
    changed=True

        changed=False

                if i>=2 and j>=2: cands.append(val(i,31-j)) # col mirror

                if cands:
                    assert len(set(cands))==1,(i,j,cands)
                    g[i][j]=cands[0]; changed=True
    return g
